title: HTTPS / TLS Certificate Failure on Custom Domain
symptom: Browser displays 'Your connection is not private' (SSL_ERROR_BAD_CERT_DOMAIN or CERT_HAS_EXPIRED).
initial_observations: HTTP works or redirects to HTTPS.
HTTPS handshake fails with certificate validation error.
environment: AWS ACM certificate attached to ALB or CloudFront distribution.

possible_causes.cause: ACM certificate was requested in wrong region (CloudFront requires us-east-1)
possible_causes.evidence_needed: CloudFront distribution cannot attach certificate created in eu-west-1.
possible_causes.remediation: Request ACM certificate specifically in us-east-1 for CloudFront distributions.

possible_causes.cause: Certificate domain list does not include the accessed subdomain (e.g. www missing)
possible_causes.evidence_needed: openssl s_client shows Subject Alternative Names missing visited domain.
possible_causes.remediation: Request new certificate with Subject Alternative Names covering both domain.com and *.domain.com.

investigation_steps.title: Inspect Live SSL Certificate Chain
investigation_steps.command: openssl s_client -connect mydomain.com:443 -servername mydomain.com < /dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -text
investigation_steps.explanation: Examine validity dates, issuer, and Subject Alternative Names (SAN).
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Validity Not After date and X509v3 Subject Alternative Name list.

verification: curl -Iv https://mydomain.com reports successful TLS handshake and valid certificate.
prevention: Use AWS ACM managed DNS validation for automatic certificate renewals.
